recognize_zh: 周邊血中散在多個大型母細胞，染色質細緻、核質比高，其中數個細胞核的一側有清楚的杯口狀凹陷（cup-like invagination），核看起來像被挖了一口；另可見一個破裂的塗抹細胞。這種杯狀核母細胞常見於 NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD 雙突變的 AML。
features: Multiple large blasts with high N:C ratio and finely dispersed chromatin
Cup-like nuclear invaginations: pale indentation at the nuclear edge or within the nucleus in several blasts
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm without granules or Auer rods
Adjacent disrupted/smudged cell with pale cytoplasmic debris and a strand-like smudge
Red cells with refractile drying artifact; photograph through eyepiece limits fine detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows numerous large blasts with high N:C ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm. Several blasts display cup-like nuclear invaginations, seen as a pale indentation along or within the nucleus, and no Auer rods are identified. A smudged cell and strand-like debris are also present, and red cells show drying artifact. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with combined NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations; confirmatory immunophenotyping and molecular testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Hypogranular APL shows bilobed or reniform nuclei with occasional Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA, requiring urgent exclusion because both can be CD34- and HLA-DR-negative.
Monocytic cells have folded nuclei with more abundant gray, vacuolated cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity rather than a discrete cup-shaped invagination.
Lymphoblasts may have clefted nuclei but are MPO-negative and TdT-positive with lymphoid antigen expression.
